name: p-context-menu-8
title: Context menu 8
description: Context menu with switch checkbox items

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuCheckboxItem,
    ContextMenuPopup,
    ContextMenuTrigger
  } from '$lib/components/ui/context-menu';

  let autoSave = $state(true);
  let showPreview = $state(false);
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger
    class="flex h-32 w-full max-w-sm items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed text-muted-foreground text-sm"
  >
    Right click here
  </ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuPopup>
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem bind:checked={autoSave} variant="switch"
      >Auto save</ContextMenuCheckboxItem
    >
    <ContextMenuCheckboxItem bind:checked={showPreview} variant="switch"
      >Show preview</ContextMenuCheckboxItem
    >
  </ContextMenuPopup>
</ContextMenu>
